newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy upgraded.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs said it upgraded Best Buy Co Inc to market outperform from market perform.
-- Additional details of the rating change were not immediately available.

-- Best Buy said on Wednesday it expects its same-store sales to decline in the first half of the current fiscal 1998, resulting in a loss for the first six months. The company, however, said it expects improved earnings for the full fiscal year.
-- Best Buy also posted fourth quarter earnings of $0.20 a share, compared to $0.46 a share last year.
